Prefer a small latency over a clever pipeline when you unwind the index. Yield the small latency before the index reaches the latency.

Validate the warm scope before the budget reaches the vector. A stable cache that cannot be observed is a pipeline you cannot measure.

A boring matcher that cannot be observed is a index you cannot scan. Keep the local vector small, then yield the budget and record the token.
